settings open
call ext.nothingness.tapByKey key=void-settings-dot-show-song-info

shoot dot_songinfo_normal

# Normal text size (1.0)
settings open
call ext.nothingness.tapByKey key=void-settings-dot-show-song-info
# text size slider: drag far right to 1.5, then back to normal is hard; instead set to max first, then set normal by drag less.
# We'll assume default is 1.0; after enabling overlay we keep as-is.
settings close
shoot dot_songinfo_normal

# Maximum text size (1.5)
settings open
call ext.nothingness.tapByKey key=void-settings-dot-show-song-info
call ext.nothingness.dragByKey key=void-settings-dot-text-size dx=400 dy=0 steps=25
settings close
shoot dot_songinfo_max
edits.newText:
# Normal text size (uiScale=1.0)
call ext.nothingness.setSetting name=uiScale value=1.0
settings open
call ext.nothingness.tapByKey key=void-settings-dot-show-song-info
settings close
shoot dot_songinfo_normal

# Maximum text size (uiScale=3.0)
call ext.nothingness.setSetting name=uiScale value=3.0
# showSongInfo must remain enabled (persistent per hero), so just screenshot.
shoot dot_songinfo_max
